			clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ITA_merge max = 0.03 }
			subtract_from_variable = { party_pop_array^23 = COLDWAR_ITA_merge }
			add_to_variable = { party_pop_array^20 = COLDWAR_ITA_merge }
			recalculate_party = yes
		}
	}

	title = COLDWAR_ITA.101.t
	desc = COLDWAR_ITA.101.d
	picture = GFX_ICW_EVT_country_news_event_generic_sign_treaty1

	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_ITA.101"
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_dc_gas_for_pipes FROM = { tag = SOV has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_dc_gas_for_pipes } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_dc_gas_for_pipes = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_dc_comiso FROM = { tag = USA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_dc_comiso } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_dc_comiso = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_dc_petrodollars_fiat FROM = { tag = LBA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_dc_petrodollars_fiat } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_dc_petrodollars_fiat = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_pri_mediterranean_anchor FROM = { tag = USA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_pri_mediterranean_anchor } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_pri_mediterranean_anchor = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_psdi_atlantic_guarantee FROM = { tag = USA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_psdi_atlantic_guarantee } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_psdi_atlantic_guarantee = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_mediterranean_bridge FROM = { tag = LBA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_mediterranean_bridge } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_mediterranean_bridge = yes
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ITA_offer_amount = FROM.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ITA_offer_amount = 0.002 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_amount }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_comiso_base FROM = { tag = USA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_comiso_base } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_comiso_base = yes
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_ITA_cwtension_p1_tt
			hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 1 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_spirit_of_osimo FROM = { tag = SER has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_spirit_of_osimo } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_spirit_of_osimo = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_fraternal_ties FROM = { tag = SOV has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_fraternal_ties } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_fraternal_ties = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_eurocommunist_axis FROM = { tag = FRA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_eurocommunist_axis } }

		}

			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_euromissile_moratorium FROM = { tag = USA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_euromissile_moratorium } }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_teachers_for_mogadishu FROM = { tag = SOM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_teachers_for_mogadishu } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_teachers_for_mogadishu = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_oil_for_engineers FROM = { tag = LBA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_oil_for_engineers } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_oil_for_engineers = yes
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ITA_offer_amount = FROM.gdp_total }

			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_southern_front_line FROM = { tag = USA has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_southern_front_line } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_southern_front_line = yes

				name = COLDWAR_ITA_msi_d1
				bonus = 0.5
				uses = 1
				category = CAT_naval
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_gas_for_pipes FROM = { tag = SOV has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_gas_for_pipes } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_gas_for_pipes = yes

			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.003 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_offer_fiat_licence FROM = { tag = SOV has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_partner_signed_fiat_licence } }
			COLDWAR_ITA_deal_sign_fiat_licence = yes

			modify_treasury_effect = yes

			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.003 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes mdcw_cw_update_world_market = yes } }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_ITA.101.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_ITA.101 option a"
	}
}
